en: A sepia-toned photograph mounted on a postcard card-stock showing a somewhat dilapidated multi‑storey residential building forming a corner in a small courtyard. Leafless trees stand in front, along with a wooden fence, cart, and scattered materials. The facade has classical window framing but peeling plaster. A person stands in a doorway at the right. Handwritten captions in German appear around the image, including one along the bottom margin identifying the corner and street, and another at the upper right margin. A small signature is at the lower right.
